items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer mentions Teddy Wilson coming to NY to play with Benny Carter; Interviewee responds 'Teddy recommended Keg.'

ctx.x: You know, you're so very much right about the Benny Carter laboratory. I don't know whether it was official or not, but you must put John Hammond in there, who always liked Benny Carter, and he was the one who... Remember in 1932, he was the one that John Hammond recommended... He'd heard Teddy Wilson in Chicago, and told Benny Carter "Why don't you send for Teddy Wilson?" So Teddy Wilson came into New York to play with Benny Carter's band on the suggestion of John Hammond. And of course, when he got there, he'd…

Teddy recommended Keg Johnson. They had all been living in the same house together, Miss Artis(?), in Chicago, see -- you know, old buddies -- and had been working on the same gig. So they sent for Keg Johnson. Now, Keg was my biggest friend. So my heart was broken because nobody had sent for me. You see? Then Keg Johnson gets in Benny Carter's band, as you say. And when you get in there, as Danny said, this is where everybody's looking. You're in the laboratory now. Anybody who is looking to get some musicians…
